description: Returns a single rate value reachable by the project (project-level override or merged company-level value), including historical (expired/soft-deleted) values. Returns 404 when the value is unreachable by the project. A merged company value reports the company rate table id in rate_table_id.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the company

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the project

parameters.name: rate_value_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the rate value

200.description: Rate value retrieved successfully. Surfaces history: expired and soft-deleted values are returned. A merged company value reports the COMPANY rate table id in rate_table_id.

batch_job_id.description: When the flat value is queued for async promotion, the background job id to poll via GET .../batch_jobs/:id until status is COMPLETED.

id.description: Unique identifier of the rate value

created_by.description: Login of the user who created the rate value

updated_by.description: Login of the user who last updated the rate value

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.
